release.name: Unova Together 2.0.31 - Trainer looks and dialogue tools
release.body:
# Unova Together 2.0.31 — Trainer outfit filters and dialogue tools

- Filter player appearance by trainer outfit to find matching walking characters more easily.
- Includes the 2.0.30 fix for optional area battle scenery with prepared game copies.
- Adds developer tools for validating and previewing branching dialogue and safely packing event/text archives. These are local authoring tools; no new in-game dialogue event is installed.

Use the same release and supported Blaze Black 2 Redux Complete v1.4.1 game version as your friends. Co-op experience remains disabled.

removedReleaseMetadata.name: Developer preview: ROM dialogue authoring tools (not a game update)
removedReleaseMetadata.body:
This developer prerelease packages the ROM dialogue authoring workflow and interactive local preview from Unova Together commit 3cbad2c294e2c597910a9cf980e41305231b5b58.

It includes a safety-checked wrapper for two pinned Black 2/White 2 decomp data packers, sample data-driven dialogue, and an HTML preview with expression-aware missing-art fallbacks. It does not add portrait rendering to the game, patch a ROM, or change the player launcher. No ROM, save, firmware, decomp checkout, or Pokémon artwork is included.

The tools are distributed under the repository's GPL-3.0-or-later license. See the included authorship, licensing, and workflow documents for attribution, setup, and limits.

removedReleaseMetadata.name: Unova Together 2.0.29 — Reliable game preparation
removedReleaseMetadata.body:
# Unova Together 2.0.29 — Reliable game preparation

Fixed a launcher hang that could leave **Play** stuck on “Preparing Cynthia.” Optional battle scenery and game-copy preparation now run in the background, and the launcher recovers if preparation fails. Your original game file and saves remain unchanged.

Please update the launcher and try starting the game again. The full first-time scenery setup may take a little while, but the launcher should remain responsive while it runs.

removedReleaseMetadata.name: Unova Together 2.0.28 — Smoother game launch preparation
removedReleaseMetadata.body:
# Unova Together 2.0.28 — Smoother game launch preparation

Starting the game no longer leaves the launcher unresponsive while it prepares the Route 7 event-ready game copy or your selected field character. Preparation now runs in the background, and errors return the launcher to a usable state with a clear message.

This is a launcher reliability update. Your original game file and saves are kept.

removedReleaseMetadata.name: Unova Together 2.0.27 — Area-based battle scenery (test release)
removedReleaseMetadata.body:
# Unova Together 2.0.27 — Area-based battle scenery (test release)

Battle scenery can now reflect the area where an encounter begins, while keeping the center open for the Pokémon. Enable **Area battle scenery** in launcher settings to try it. If the game cannot confirm the area, it keeps the original battle background.

This is a test release. Please try wild and trainer battles in indoor and outdoor areas, especially just after changing maps, and report any scenery that hides the action or shows the wrong area.

Use the same release and supported Blaze Black 2 Redux Complete v1.4.1 game version as your friends. Existing saves remain compatible.

removedReleaseMetadata.name: Unova Together 2.0.26 — Clearer co-op setup and scenery layering
removedReleaseMetadata.body:
# Unova Together 2.0.26

- Improved scenery layering for Pokémon followers, co-op players and their shadows.
- Improved recovery from outdated local player-sharing relays that can prevent Teleport. Both players should update and reconnect through the launcher.
- Added an in-launcher Tailscale setup walkthrough, with guidance for LAN and other connection options.
- Refreshed Play and Features with credited Mega sprite artwork, a responsive card layout and animated previews that load when needed.

Use the same release and Blaze Black 2 Redux Complete v1.4.1 game version as your friends. Existing saves remain compatible. Co-op experience remains disabled.

removedReleaseMetadata.name: Unova Together 2.0.25 — Make the overworld character your own
removedReleaseMetadata.body:
# Make the overworld character your own

Choose from animated people and Pokémon available in your compatible game. Search and filter the list, preview walking animations, save favorites, and keep named looks with each game profile. Your selection takes effect the next time you start the game.

The available characters depend on the game you selected. This changes the normal walking appearance; other movement forms and battle portraits are unchanged.
